goal: Scaffold Maven project: pom.xml (parent 3.5.7, java 21, web, jdbc, sqlite-jdbc, test, boot plugin), ShortenerApplication entry point, ReadyListener printing SERVICE_READY port=<port> on ApplicationReadyEvent, application.properties (PORT, SQLite datasource with pool size 1, sql init always, problemdetails, no stacktrace), schema.sql with approved DDL, .gitignore, and a context-load smoke test using a temp SQLite file.
done_criteria: mvn -B verify compiles, the context loads against a temp SQLite file, schema is applied, and SERVICE_READY port=<port> is printed once on startup.

goal: Implement UrlValidator, ShortCodeGenerator, and the exceptions InvalidUrlException and LinkNotFoundException, with unit tests.
done_criteria: Validator accepts only absolute http/https URLs with a host and rejects null, blank, relative, malformed and other-scheme values. Generator yields 7-char base62 codes. Tests pass.

goal: Implement ShortLinkRepository (JdbcTemplate insert, findByCode, incrementClick, findLongUrl) with a ShortLink record, ISO-8601 UTC microsecond timestamps, and repository tests on a temp SQLite file.
done_criteria: Insert, duplicate-key surfacing, lookup, and atomic click increment (returning affected rows) work. Tests pass.

goal: Implement LinkService: create with up to 5 collision retries, getDetails, getAnalytics, and transactional resolveAndCount, with unit tests.
done_criteria: Service creates independent links, retries on collision, increments clicks, throws LinkNotFoundException for unknown codes without changing rows. Tests pass.

goal: Implement DTOs, LinkController, RedirectController and ProblemExceptionHandler per the OpenAPI contract, with MockMvc tests covering all endpoints and error statuses.
done_criteria: POST returns 201 with Location; the redirect returns 302 with Location and Cache-Control no-store; details and analytics return 200; errors return 400, 404 and 415 as application/problem+json; mvn -B verify passes.
